text: $SAND surged to $0.07607, up 20.06% in 24 h, trading between $0.06316 and $0.08396 with over $62 M volume. $QNT jumped 16.71% to $268.55, its range was $224.61-$270 and it moved $62 M of USDT. Meanwhile $BTC barely budged, inching up 0.251% to $84,704, max $85,037, min $84,422 and crushing $576 M in volume. The meme-play and the quant token are pulling ahead while Bitcoin's just holding the line. Looks like the alt side got the party started, Bitcoin stayed on standby.

$BTC slipped to $84,787, down 0.452% on the day. It bounced up to a high of $85,297 before falling back to a low of $83,888, giving it the widest price swing of the three.

$ETH hovered around $2,679, a 0.495% drop, with a high of $2,695.96 and a low of $2,650.88.

$BNB edged up 0.527% to $777.80, trading between $760.35 and $779.25. Its 86,580 BNB traded was the heftiest volume in pure token terms.

Overall, BTC's range stole the show.

$TSLAB is up 4.079% at 371 USDT, nudged up from a low of 356 and peaking at 374.61. The surge kept rolling through the night, so you're still seeing that upside even when NY's closed.

$MUB slipped 2.43% to 1,069.58 USDT, hovering just above its low of 1,065.73 and well under the recent high of 1,113.09. Volume sat around 4.37 M USDT, showing decent activity despite the dip.

$CRCLB fell 3.112% to 82.19 USDT, stuck between a 80.22 floor and an 88.37 ceiling. It's moved a hefty 24.64 M USDT in trades, so the tokenized stock is still busy even off-hours.

All three keep ticking 24/7, so the price action you see now isn't just a flash-point, it's the real-time feel of the market outside the usual bell.
